description: This file implements the rx::Image11 class, which manages Direct3D 11 texture resources, including staging textures, data loading, copying, and mipmap generation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: Image11
classes.description: Manages Direct3D 11 texture resources, including staging textures, data loading, copying, and mipmap generation within ANGLE.

methods.name: GenerateMipmap
methods.description: Generates mipmaps for the source image into the destination image.

methods.name: CopyImage
methods.description: Copies a specified region from the source image to the destination image.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the image has unsaved changes or needs updating.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies image data to a TextureStorage object.

methods.name: verifyAssociatedStorageValid
methods.description: Verifies that the associated storage is valid.

methods.name: recoverFromAssociatedStorage
methods.description: Recovers image data from associated storage if needed.

methods.name: disassociateStorage
methods.description: Disassociates the image from its current storage.

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Redefines the image with new parameters.

methods.name: getDXGIFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format of the image.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads pixel data into the image.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed pixel data into the image.

methods.name: copyFromTexStorage
methods.description: Copies data from a TextureStorage to the image.

methods.name: copyFromFramebuffer
methods.description: Copies data from a framebuffer attachment to the image.

methods.name: getStagingTexture
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the staging texture.

methods.name: createStagingTexture
methods.description: Creates a staging texture for the image.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps the staging texture for CPU access.

methods.name: unmap
methods.description: Unmaps the staging texture after CPU access.
